name: Age of Ascent: Arrival
author: IllyriadGames
description:
Escort the barge to safety and beat the enemy ships!

You have been hired for this escort mission to get the warp barge safely to its destination. Space looks quiet and it should be an easy journey… but the enemy is lurking and ready to take you down. Survive the enemy onslaught, destroy their ships and get the warp barge home – or be destroyed! Instructions to play are in the tutorial at the start of the game and a controls graphic shows you how to get the most out of your ships.

Age of Ascent: Arrival is a mini-game preview of our early release, due out soon. Illyriad Games Ltd. is a small UK-based indie dev team with a focus on MMO’s and co-ops with direct play and deep strategy.
